heading: Private synced bibliographies
intro: Create a private BibTeX link from saved paper metadata, then explicitly replace its references as your review changes. Anyone with the link can download it until you revoke it.
source: References come from this browser’s saved literature workspace. Personal notes, screening decisions and your research question are excluded. No paper is read and nothing is sent to a provider.
replaceConfirm: Replace this bibliography with {count} currently saved papers? Its private link stays the same. Notes and screening decisions are excluded.
revokeConfirm: Revoke this private link and delete its server snapshot? Copies already downloaded elsewhere cannot be recalled.
created: Link created. Copy and save it now; it cannot be retrieved again after leaving this page.
updated: References replaced. The same link now serves this snapshot. Refresh the linked file in your writing tool to retrieve it.
revoked: Link revoked and server snapshot deleted. Existing downloaded copies remain.
secretLabel: Private bearer URL (shown once; keep it secret)
copied: Private URL copied to your clipboard.
empty: No private bibliographies saved for this signed-in owner.
unavailable: Private bibliographies are unavailable on this deployment. Your browser workspace is unchanged.
invalid: Check the review name and saved paper metadata, or reduce the bibliography size.
conflict: This bibliography or signed-in owner changed. Reload before making another change.
limit: This bibliography exceeds the storage limit. Remove a saved bibliography or reduce the snapshot.
failed: The request could not be confirmed. It may already have applied. Reload to inspect the saved state; no request is automatically retried.
clipboardFailed: Clipboard access failed. Select and copy the private URL manually.
boundary: This publishes a metadata snapshot only when you choose Create or Replace. It does not automatically track workspace edits or synchronize Zotero. Revocation stops future downloads, not copies already imported.
